theorem_rows.name: pressure_gap_ht_equivalence
theorem_rows.statement: For target W>=1, target_W-replay_W>=1 is equivalent to 2T-H<=2W-3, or H-2T>=3-2W.

theorem_rows.name: current_prime_rho_hits_satisfy_ht_normal_form
theorem_rows.statement: Every current prime rho hit satisfies the H,T normal-form inequality.

theorem_rows.name: global_ht_inequality_for_prime_rho_hits
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof must derive 2T-H<=2W-3 for prime rho hits, or route equality failure to full-shape overlap PDEC.

plain_conclusion: 本步把素数 rho 命中的 pressure gap 正规化为 H,T 不等式：`target_W-replay_W>=1` 当且仅当 `2T-H<=2W-3`，等价于 `H-2T>=3-2W`。当前 344 个素数 rho 命中全部满足该不等式；最小正规形 slack 为 0，边界 slack=0 的命中数为 1。

decision_rows.meaning: 当前全部素数 rho 命中满足 H,T 正规形不等式。
仍需全局证明 prime rho hit 强制该 H,T 不等式。
本步只完成 pressure gap 的 H,T 正规形，不关闭全局行/列命题。
